description: The npm package `saferemove` installs the `saferm` binary with no install script: each platform's binary ships in its own package (`saferemove-linux-x64`, `saferemove-linux-arm64`, `saferemove-darwin-x64`, and `saferemove-darwin-arm64`), which npm picks through `optionalDependencies`, so an install with scripts turned off (npm's default from npm 12) still provides `saferm` and nothing is downloaded at install time. The PyPI package `saferm` is a binary wheel per platform carrying the binary itself, with no download on first run.

Releases carry no Windows archive any more, and the npm and PyPI packages support Linux and macOS on x64 and arm64 only; on Windows, install with `go install github.com/stricttools/saferm@v0`. The PyPI package `saferm` no longer contains a Python module, so `import saferm` and `python -m saferm` stop working; run the `saferm` command it installs.
